heroHeadline: Speculation Builds Over Puerto Rico Homecoming Shows at Hiram Bithorn — Still Unconfirmed as Tour Closure Nears
heroSubtitle: The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour closed as planned at King Baudouin Stadium in Brussels on July 22, grossing approximately $467.5 million across 55 shows — the highest-grossing tour ever by a Latin artist. Since then, speculation has built that Bad Bunny will add a homecoming coda in Puerto Rico: San Juan Mayor Miguel Romero confirmed Rimas Entertainment has reserved Estadio Hiram Bithorn for August 21–23, and sponsors including T-Mobile, Medalla Light, and CeraVe have teased an unnamed event at the stadium alongside visible construction and staging. A source close to Bad Bunny's team told El Nuevo Día the plan is for three closing shows, but as of this update neither Bad Bunny nor Rimas Entertainment has issued an official confirmation, exact dates, or ticket on-sale.
